caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure with a carved wooden head featuring painted black hair, a black beard, bushy black eyebrows, green eyes, and red cheeks and lips. The figure wears a small, round cap with colorful horizontal bands in red, blue, and yellow. Its clothing consists of a dark navy or black jacket with long sleeves and a white collar, and pale beige or white trousers. The puppet has light beige-gloved hands, one positioned across its chest while the other hangs down, and its shoes appear black. The composition places the figure centered on a plain, light beige background. There are no other objects present in the drawing. The artist’s signature, “CHARL MAKERNG,” is in the lower right corner.
title: Barnacle Bill Puppet
